pages.mainText: Discover Valiram Ambition Fuelled by Heritage, Elevated Through Luxury Valiram's story began in 1935 with a daring leap of faith. From a small family-run trading company in Kuala Lumpur, founded with little more than ambition and resilience, the seeds were sown for what would become one of Asia Pacific's most dynamic and respected luxury retail groups. Built on a foundation of courage, grit, and entrepreneurial vision, Valiram expanded from trading into duty-free retail in the 1970s. A bold new chapter unfolded in 2001 with the launch of Flying Emporium at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA)—a luxury multi-brand concept store that redefined travel retail in the region. Over the years, the Group has grown to represent some of the world’s most iconic names in fashion, beauty, fine timepieces, and lifestyle-bringing elevated retail experiences to new and emerging markets. Today, Valiram operates across 9 countries — Australia, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Macau, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam — with 600+ stores for 200+ brands, powered by a vibrant team of 6,000+ employees representing 40+ nationalities and ethnicities. Brands 0 + Stores 0 + Countries 0 Employees 0 + Nationalities 0 + Customers 0 mil Though Valiram’s footprint spans nine countries, it remains proudly family-owned, with operations led by a diverse team of professionals across the region. Guided by a bold ambition to be the best retailer on the planet, the Group remains anchored by its purpose: to bring joy to the communities we serve, to the people we work with, and to every customer we welcome. What sets Valiram apart is not just the brands it represents, but also its rare culture of collaboration, creativity, and continuous innovation. These values are the heartbeat of the company-shaping extraordinary experiences and futureready retail concepts. Leading the FUTURE of RETAIL At the helm of Valiram’s next chapter is a dynamic new generation of leadership-Dato’ Sharan Valiram, Dato’ Ashvin Valiram, and Mukesh Valiram— Executive Directors who are steering the Group boldly into the future. Together, they form a unified leadership team, blending individual strengths with a shared vision. As a collective, they have not only upheld the company’s rich legacy but redefined what it means to lead in the world of luxury retail across Asia Pacific. Under their stewardship, Valiram has expanded into new markets, introduced groundbreaking retail concepts, and transformed the shopping experience-breaking barriers and setting benchmarks along the way. Their leadership is marked by a relentless pursuit of innovation and a deeprooted belief in people. With a people-first mindset, they champion a culture of empowerment, inclusivity, and collaboration-believing that the strength of the business lies in the talent, passion, and creativity of its people. As catalysts for progress, Dato’ Sharan, Ashvin, and Mukesh continue to elevate Valiram’s global presence while staying true to its founding values. Their vision not only shapes the company’s future-it inspires the industry at large. Luxury Retail Excellence At Valiram, excellence is not just an aspiration-it’s a mindset. The Group thrives on collaboration, creativity, and innovation, cultivating a dynamic culture where bold ideas come to life. This spirit fuels exceptional experiences and continuously raises the bar for what luxury retail can be-modern, meaningful, and unmistakably Valiram.

searchResults.title: About Valiram – Valiram
searchResults.highlight:
#### Valiram's story began in 1935 with a daring leap of faith. From a small family-run trading company in Kuala Lumpur, founded with little more than ambition and resilience, the seeds were sown for what would become one of Asia Pacific's most dynamic and respected luxury retail groups.
...
Built on a foundation of courage, grit, and entrepreneurial vision, Valiram expanded from trading into duty-free retail in the 1970s. A bold new chapter unfolded in 2001 with the launch of Flying Emporium at Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA)—a luxury multi-brand concept store that redefined travel retail in the region.
...
Over the years, the Group has grown to represent some of the world’s most iconic names in fashion, beauty, fine timepieces, and lifestyle-bringing elevated retail experiences to new and emerging markets.
...
##### Today, Valiram operates across 9 countries — Australia, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Macau, Malaysia, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam — with 600+ stores for 200+ brands, powered by a vibrant team of 6,000+ employees representing 40+ nationalities and ethnicities.
...
Though Valiram’s footprint spans nine countries, it remains proudly family-owned, with operations led by a diverse team of professionals across the region. Guided by a bold ambition to be the best retailer on the planet, the Group remains anchored by its purpose: to bring joy to the communities we serve, to the people we work with, and to every customer we welcome.
...
What sets Valiram apart is not just the brands it represents, but also its rare culture of collaboration, creativity, and continuous innovation. These values are the heartbeat of the company-shaping extraordinary experiences and futureready retail concepts.
...
At the helm of Valiram’s next chapter is a dynamic new generation of leadership-Dato’ Sharan Valiram, Dato’ Ashvin Valiram, and Mukesh Valiram— Executive Directors who are steering the Group boldly into the future. Together, they form a unified leadership team, blending individual strengths with a shared vision. As a collective, they have not only upheld the company’s rich legacy but redefined what it means to lead in the world of luxury retail across Asia Pacific. Under their stewardship, Valiram has expanded into new markets, introduced groundbreaking retail concepts, and transformed the shopping experience-breaking barriers and setting benchmarks along the way.
...
Their leadership is marked by a relentless pursuit of innovation and a deeprooted belief in people. With a people-first mindset, they champion a culture of empowerment, inclusivity, and collaboration-believing that the strength of the business lies in the talent, passion, and creativity of its people. As catalysts for progress, Dato’ Sharan, Ashvin, and Mukesh continue to elevate Valiram’s global presence while staying true to its founding values. Their vision not only shapes the company’s future-it inspires the industry at large.
...
At Valiram, excellence is not just an aspiration-it’s a mindset. The Group thrives on collaboration, creativity, and innovation, cultivating a dynamic culture where bold ideas come to life. This spirit fuels exceptional experiences and continuously raises the bar for what luxury retail can be-modern, meaningful, and unmistakably Valiram.
